name: Short-podded thelypody
desc: Short-podded thelypody (Thelypodium brachycarpum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Thelypodium brachycarpum is a species of flowering plant in the mustard family known by the common names shortpod thelypody and short-podded thelypodium.
